Смахните в любую сторону — змея повернёт:
Swipe in any direction — the snake turns that way (a 20-point dead zone, two turns are remembered ahead). In the game settings you can switch to taps on the screen halves: left turns left, right turns right.

**Fruit** grows the snake: +1 length and +1 score. Eat the glade's goal and an **exit** opens on the edge.

**Length is health.** Hitting a wall or a stone costs 3 segments and half a second standing still: the snake waits for a new direction. Biting yourself cuts off the tail. Shorter than 3 — the run is over.

A **curio** (the ring) pauses the game and offers one of three abilities. Between lands there is a **burrow**: a shop for seeds.

Three lands — Meadow, Bog, Stone Ridge — three glades each, the third is the master's lair. After a victory — the Endless Trail.

**Scales** from a run open the workshop and new snakes. A win on the highest molt unlocks the next: each gives +10 % scales and a new, harder rule.

Double tap — dash (if you have it), hold a finger — curl up (if you have it).
